instruction:
I want VLC to automatically loop videos when they finish playing. Please enable the loop/repeat mode in VLC.
How can I set this up?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling VLC's loop mode (loop=1). Created custom metric function check_vlc_loop_mode__23c7a390. Expected value is 1 (enabled).

Expected value of 1 is semantically correct for VLC's loop mode enabled state
